title: Kenworth T659 series Heavy Duty Road Train FUPS Bullbar #57
description: Kenworth T659 high tensile powder coated high tensile aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar pressed style channel. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Five post design ensures maximum protection to the bonnet and radiator. 100mm box uprights extended to cow catcher. Minimum bonnet to upright clearance to all for maximum dimension combinations. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Optional Dangerous Goods sign. Provision for front mudflaps. Heavy duty steel backing plate with tow pin. Custom centre driving light mounts plus upper outer driving light mounts. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
